items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: I'm the Reverend Alexander Griffin, or whatever, and I want to welcome all these people.

ctx.x: I Will Be Somewhere Working for the Lord.

Yeah, that's a good record, and I like that one. And then the other one that I have that I bought that same summer, is a Kid Howard record that was all hymns, and is recorded in the Zion Hill Baptist Church. And it starts off with a little welcome by the preacher, the minister of the church. I'm the Reverend Alexander Griffin, or whatever, and I want to welcome all these people. And that's, I enjoy that. But those, you know, I really, and last summer, again, is a bewildering array of records, and you don't know…
Yeah. Well, that narrows it down. Yeah.
